description_en: Retrieves the system command line output of an instance. The data is returned in Base64-encoded format
description_zh: 获取一台实例的系统命令行输出，数据以Base64编码后返回
kebab_example: aliyun ecs get-instance-console-output --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1c1xhsrac2coiw0000 --remove-symbols false --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceConsoleOutput

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
parameters.description_zh: 实例所在地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to remove formatting symbols from the returned text. Valid values:

- true: Remove formatting symbols.
- false: Do not remove formatting symbols.

Default value: false.
parameters.description_zh:
是否去除返回文本中的排版符号。取值范围：
- true：去除
- false：不去除

默认值：false
